text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I go into town and spot Gold City standing in front of a shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I think you looked more delicate and cute in the other pumps.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eep! Delicate? I see, that's a new one for me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: As you can tell, I'm tagging along with these two while they shop. Like a chaperone, kinda.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yukino and I wanted to get some stuff, and we thought we'd ask City for advice! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, City! Which d'you suppose I get, pumps or loafers?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I think the loafers will be more versatile with your wardrobe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But if you want to try something new, footwear is the place to start. So, in that case, I'd recommend the pumps.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Th-then I'll buy the pumps!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Cool, you've got this.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yukino, I'm glad you found something nice! ♪ Now, it's my turn.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, you want to join us? I need to hear all types of opinions! ☆ Pleeeease! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling the pressure from Curren Chan's request, I decide to join the three of them shopping.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, I'm curious about this line's toner, but what's like the opinion on it in the industry?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Geez Louise, I don't have the darndest clue what you're talkin' 'bout, Curren…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You really are quick to pick up on trends. Yeah, there's been a lot of buzz about it, but…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: From what my makeup artist said, it'd be better to wait and see. The all-natural line over there will give you similar effects for a cheaper price.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Okay, I'll do that! I'm glad I could talk to a pro! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. So, now that you've both bought something, are we good for today?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! I wanna see what you're gonna buy too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! I wanna too! You always give me advice, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I nev'r get t'see an actual example of a city girl shopp'n!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Umm… It's not like I do anything special. Besides, I don't particularly want or need anything right now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: At least tell us what's on your radar lately.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh hey, I bet you know what's on City's wishlist.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you asking my trainer for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since I see her quite often, I do have some idea as to what might pique her interest…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wha… How do you know that?
choice_data_list: I've seen you looking at shoes quite a lot recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She kept looking at her feet during practice yesterday, and just now at the store with Yukino Bijin, she kept glancing at shoes on display.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy macaroni! You're so attentive. I didn't notice at all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I knew I could ask you. Well then, let's go check out some shoes for training! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo, you wouldn't happen to know what shoes she'd want to buy, would you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not fully confident, but I find a pair I think she might like.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No way… Does that mean it was on the money?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, get outta here! You're super observant… Or could there be something more to it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You need to stop it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She glares at me with daggers in her eyes…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Why?
choice_data_list: This is your usual snack time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To avoid getting overly hungry, she always snacks on a little something every couple of hours.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy smokes… That's just like a model! Oh—but you are a model!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The real deal. ♪ Anyway, I could go for something sweet too. How about crepes?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Just a drink, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm watching my calorie intake… even though a crepe does sound good right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're such a model!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City appears a bit conflicted, probably because she actually wants to have a crepe too. In that case…
choice_data_list: Can you eat my crepe for me?
Can you eat my crepe for me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What? But you ordered that. Plus, you haven't even touched it.
choice_data_list: I realized I'm not actually hungry. Please!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Stupid. You're too nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says this as she takes my crepe, but I can tell I've made her happy.
